005package org.wpilib.tunable;
006
007import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import java.util.function.DoubleConsumer;
010import java.util.function.DoubleSupplier;
011import java.util.function.IntConsumer;
012import java.util.function.IntSupplier;
013import java.util.function.LongConsumer;
014import java.util.function.LongSupplier;
015import java.util.function.Supplier;
016import org.wpilib.util.function.BooleanConsumer;
017import org.wpilib.util.function.FloatConsumer;
018import org.wpilib.util.function.FloatSupplier;
019
020/**
021 * Tunables are used to allow values in the robot program to be changed from dashboards or debug
022 * tools.
023 *
024 * <p>Getter/setter-backed publish methods take getters and setters that must not throw.
025 *
026 * <p>For more advanced use cases, use NetworkTables directly.
027 */
028public final class Tunables {
029  /** The root {@link TunableTable}. */
030  private static final TunableTable m_root = TunableRegistry.getTable("/");
031
032  private Tunables() {
033    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
034  }
035
036  /**
037   * Gets the root tunable table.
038   *
039   * @return table
040   */
041  public static TunableTable getTable() {
042    return m_root;
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Gets a child tunable table.
047   *
048   * @param name table name
049   * @return table
050   */
051  public static TunableTable getTable(String name) {
052    return m_root.getTable(name);
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Creates and publishes a tunable value.
057   *
058   * @param <T> value type
059   * @param name the name
060   * @param initialValue the initial value
061   * @return tunable
062   */
063  public static <T> Tunable<T> addValue(String name, T initialValue) {
064    Tunable<T> tunable = Tunable.create(initialValue);
065    publish(name, tunable);
066    return tunable;
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Creates and publishes a tunable boolean value.
071   *
072   * @param name the name
073   * @param initialValue the initial value
074   * @return tunable
075   */
076  public static TunableBoolean addBoolean(String name, boolean initialValue) {
077    TunableBoolean tunable = TunableBoolean.create(initialValue);
078    publish(name, tunable);
079    return tunable;
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Creates and publishes a tunable integer value.
084   *
085   * @param name the name
086   * @param initialValue the initial value
087   * @return tunable
088   */
089  public static TunableInt addInt(String name, int initialValue) {
090    TunableInt tunable = TunableInt.create(initialValue);
091    publish(name, tunable);
092    return tunable;
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Creates and publishes a tunable long value.
097   *
098   * @param name the name
099   * @param initialValue the initial value
100   * @return tunable
101   */
102  public static TunableLong addLong(String name, long initialValue) {
103    TunableLong tunable = TunableLong.create(initialValue);
104    publish(name, tunable);
105    return tunable;
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Creates and publishes a tunable float value.
110   *
111   * @param name the name
112   * @param initialValue the initial value
113   * @return tunable
114   */
115  public static TunableFloat addFloat(String name, float initialValue) {
116    TunableFloat tunable = TunableFloat.create(initialValue);
117    publish(name, tunable);
118    return tunable;
119  }
120
121  /**
122   * Creates and publishes a tunable double value.
123   *
124   * @param name the name
125   * @param initialValue the initial value
126   * @return tunable
127   */
128  public static TunableDouble addDouble(String name, double initialValue) {
129    TunableDouble tunable = TunableDouble.create(initialValue);
130    publish(name, tunable);
131    return tunable;
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Publishes a tunable.
136   *
137   * @param name the name
138   * @param tunable the tunable
139   * @return true if the backend accepted the tunable
140   */
141  public static boolean publish(String name, TunableBase tunable) {
142    return m_root.publish(name, tunable);
143  }
144
145  /**
146   * Publishes a complex tunable.
147   *
148   * @param name the name
149   * @param tunable the tunable
150   * @return true if the backend accepted the tunable
151   */
152  public static boolean publish(String name, ComplexTunable tunable) {
153    return m_root.publish(name, tunable);
154  }
155
156  /**
157   * Publishes a tunable value using a getter and setter.
158   *
159   * @param <T> value type
160   * @param name the name
161   * @param getter the getter
162   * @param setter the setter
163   * @param cls the class of the value
164   * @return the tunable
165   */
166  public static <T> Tunable<T> publishValue(
167      String name, Supplier<T> getter, Consumer<T> setter, Class<T> cls) {
168    return m_root.publishValue(name, getter, setter, cls);
169  }
170
171  /**
172   * Publishes a tunable value using a getter and setter.
173   *
174   * @param <T> value type
175   * @param name the name
176   * @param getter the getter
177   * @param setter the setter
178   * @param cls the class of the value
179   * @param config tunable config
180   * @return the tunable
181   */
182  public static <T> Tunable<T> publishValue(
183      String name, Supplier<T> getter, Consumer<T> setter, Class<T> cls, TunableConfig config) {
184    return m_root.publishValue(name, getter, setter, cls, config);
185  }
186
187  /**
188   * Publishes a tunable boolean value using a getter and setter.
189   *
190   * @param name the name
191   * @param getter the getter
192   * @param setter the setter
193   * @return the tunable
194   */
195  public static TunableBoolean publishBoolean(
196      String name, BooleanSupplier getter, BooleanConsumer setter) {
197    return m_root.publishBoolean(name, getter, setter);
198  }
199
200  /**
201   * Publishes a tunable boolean value using a getter and setter.
202   *
203   * @param name the name
204   * @param getter the getter
205   * @param setter the setter
206   * @param config tunable config
207   * @return the tunable
208   */
209  public static TunableBoolean publishBoolean(
210      String name, BooleanSupplier getter, BooleanConsumer setter, TunableConfig config) {
211    return m_root.publishBoolean(name, getter, setter, config);
212  }
213

215   * Publishes a tunable integer value using a getter and setter.
216   *
217   * @param name the name
218   * @param getter the getter
219   * @param setter the setter
220   * @return the tunable
221   */
222  public static TunableInt publishInt(String name, IntSupplier getter, IntConsumer setter) {
223    return m_root.publishInt(name, getter, setter);
224  }
225
226  /**
227   * Publishes a tunable integer value using a getter and setter.
228   *
229   * @param name the name
230   * @param getter the getter
231   * @param setter the setter
232   * @param config tunable config
233   * @return the tunable
234   */
235  public static TunableInt publishInt(
236      String name, IntSupplier getter, IntConsumer setter, TunableConfig config) {
237    return m_root.publishInt(name, getter, setter, config);
238  }
239
240  /**
241   * Publishes a tunable long value using a getter and setter.
242   *
243   * @param name the name
244   * @param getter the getter
245   * @param setter the setter
246   * @return the tunable
247   */
248  public static TunableLong publishLong(String name, LongSupplier getter, LongConsumer setter) {

250  }
251
252  /**
253   * Publishes a tunable long value using a getter and setter.
254   *
255   * @param name the name
256   * @param getter the getter
257   * @param setter the setter
258   * @param config tunable config
259   * @return the tunable
260   */
261  public static TunableLong publishLong(
262      String name, LongSupplier getter, LongConsumer setter, TunableConfig config) {
263    return m_root.publishLong(name, getter, setter, config);
264  }
265
266  /**
267   * Publishes a tunable float value using a getter and setter.
268   *
269   * @param name the name
270   * @param getter the getter
271   * @param setter the setter
272   * @return the tunable
273   */
274  public static TunableFloat publishFloat(String name, FloatSupplier getter, FloatConsumer setter) {

276  }
277
278  /**
279   * Publishes a tunable float value using a getter and setter.
280   *
281   * @param name the name
282   * @param getter the getter
283   * @param setter the setter
284   * @param config tunable config
285   * @return the tunable
286   */
287  public static TunableFloat publishFloat(
288      String name, FloatSupplier getter, FloatConsumer setter, TunableConfig config) {

290  }
291
292  /**
293   * Publishes a tunable double value using a getter and setter.
294   *
295   * @param name the name
296   * @param getter the getter
297   * @param setter the setter
298   * @return the tunable
299   */
300  public static TunableDouble publishDouble(
301      String name, DoubleSupplier getter, DoubleConsumer setter) {
302    return m_root.publishDouble(name, getter, setter);
303  }
304
305  /**
306   * Publishes a tunable double value using a getter and setter.
307   *
308   * @param name the name
309   * @param getter the getter
310   * @param setter the setter
311   * @param config tunable config
312   * @return the tunable
313   */
314  public static TunableDouble publishDouble(
315      String name, DoubleSupplier getter, DoubleConsumer setter, TunableConfig config) {
316    return m_root.publishDouble(name, getter, setter, config);
317  }
318
319  /**
320   * Removes a tunable.
321   *
322   * @param name the name
323   */
324  public static void remove(String name) {
325    m_root.remove(name);
326  }
327}
